tasks.protocol: Four predeclared samplers; randomized room size, partition and passage coordinates, gate priors, background observations and sensor strength; map structure supplied; initial five safe actions retained; supplied audit IDs.
tasks.limits: Controlled passage-task distribution, not general navigation prevalence. Methods share frozen learned sensor and planner. No automatic fault discovery; packet groups are revoked together, not modeled as probabilistically independent sources.

api_timing.scope: Backend revision plus 20 route forecasts plus global A*; excludes sensing, encoding, initial history ingestion, browser rendering and network. Method order randomized. Median/IQR across 24 independent histories per length; all candidate forecasts recomputed for every method to equalize downstream work.
